Needs changes before merge.

## What looks good

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trace_avoid.rs` stays under the 400-line limit (343 lines), has a clean provenance header, and has no `unwrap`, `expect`, or `panic` calls outside tests.
- When `AvoidSpec` is empty, `trace_avoid` calls `trace` directly so baseline Engrave paths do not change.
- `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs`, `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`, and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` stay in sync, and `docs/decisions/3349-engrave-do-not-touch.md` records the design choice.
- Cutting-level keep-out trimming, rapid link elevation, item-named refusals, and post blocking work across `camcraft-motion` and `camcraft-app` tests.

## Results merged with main

Ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3549`, trial-merged with `upstream/main` (`6e641dac7`):

- `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-motion --lib --test avoid_engrave --test avoid_pocket`:
  - `motion lib`: 539 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored
  - `avoid_engrave`: 4 passed, 0 failed
  - `avoid_pocket`: 3 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-app --lib` and touched suites:
  - `app lib`: 297 passed, 0 failed
  - `do_not_touch`: 3 passed, 0 failed
  - `do_not_touch_engrave`: 3 passed, 0 failed
  - `do_not_touch_project`: 3 passed, 0 failed
  - `engrave_law`: 10 passed, 0 failed
  - `mcp`: 23 passed, 0 failed
  - `mcp_doc_drift`: 6 passed, 0 failed
  - `verify`: 21 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored
- `cargo test -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): **FAILED** (1437 passed, 1 failed, 8 ignored); also failed single-threaded (`--test-threads=1`):

```text
---- egui_app::tests::do_not_touch::engrave_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_and_takes_picks stdout ----

thread 'egui_app::tests::do_not_touch::engrave_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_and_takes_picks' panicked at crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs:198:5:
assertion `left == right` failed
  left: None
 right: Some(DoNotTouch)
```

- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed (exit 0).

### Extra suites run

- `camcraft-app`: `example_catalog` (37 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_edge_work` (1 passed), `golden_cl` (33 passed), `solid_law_goldens` (7 passed), `area_controls` (13 passed), `contour_dxf_sketch` (4 passed), `corner_relief_safety` (3 passed), `tilted_gouge_kinds` (10 passed).
- `camcraft-motion`: `avoid_pocket` (3 passed).
- `camcraft-ui`: `boundary` (3 passed), `boundary_picks` (7 passed), `contour_dxf_sketch` (2 passed).

### Safety-tier mutations

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trace_avoid.rs:285`: replaced `avoid.keepout_region(z, z, AVOID_PAD)` with `Region::empty()`. `avoid_engrave` went red (`trace_avoid_keeps_flutes_shank_holder_and_links_clear` failed with Flute and Holder `AvoidHit` entries). Restored -> green.
2. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trace_avoid.rs:155`: bypassed `rotate_closed_loop_outside` (returned `vec![run]` directly). `avoid_engrave` stayed **green** (mutation survived; see finding 2 below). Restored -> green.
3. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trace_avoid.rs:335`: disabled `elevate_rapid_links`. `avoid_engrave` went red (`trace_avoid_keeps_flutes_shank_holder_and_links_clear` failed with a Shank `AvoidHit` on move 6). Restored -> green.

## Heavy lanes

`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches `motion heavy` and `app heavy` (245 steps total):
- `motion heavy`: not run - owed (all targets, triggered by `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`)
- `app heavy`: not run - owed (all targets, triggered by `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`)

The PR body reports only 3 non-ignored targets in release mode and leaves the remaining heavy steps owed. Heavy lanes were not run in full here because `camcraft-ui --lib` already fails; a green heavy result on the reworked head is required before `merge-ready`.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs:179`: `engrave_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_and_takes_picks` fails when merged with `upstream/main` (`6e641dac7`). Commit `35d28b002` (#3338) added the "Outside boundary offset" row to the Boundary group and increased the layout test height to `1200.0`. At height `1100.0`, the "Pick protected" click does not arm `BoundaryPick::DoNotTouch`. Change `.with_size(Vec2::new(1400.0, 1100.0))` to `.with_size(Vec2::new(1400.0, 1200.0))` and verify the test passes merged with `upstream/main`.
2. `crates/motion/tests/avoid_engrave.rs:127-149`: `trace_avoid_rotates_closed_loop_seam_around_overhead_plunge_blocker` does not pin `rotate_closed_loop_outside`. `Region::new` normalizes the rectangle through Clipper2, so `reg.loops()[0].points()[0]` is not `(-20, -20)`. The overhead bridge at `[-25..-10, -25..-10, 38..42]` does not cover the actual start vertex, and bypassing `rotate_closed_loop_outside` still passes the test. Read the normalized start vertex (`let seam = reg.loops()[0].points()[0];`), place the overhead bridge over `seam`, assert that plain `trace` fails `avoid_hits`, and assert that `trace_avoid` rotates the seam away and passes `avoid_hits` while still cutting through `seam`.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs` is now 401 lines (1 line over the ~400-line guideline).
- `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:168` still names only `2D Offset` and `3D Pocket` for `set_operation_do_not_touch`. That file is a process file, so leaving it for a follow-up is fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Needs changes before merge.

The head moved during the review: I started on `b7771dd43` and this comment reviews `758daa199`. The delta is the merge of `origin/main` `2de071415` (#3656, #3703, #3700) and its conflict resolution. The PR's generator and tests are byte-identical to `b7771dd43`, so the earlier findings stay closed. But the new conflict resolution does not compile.

## Blocking

1. `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:73-78`: the merge took the new `else` block and left the old closing lines below it. The file now has two `))` and two `}`. `cargo check -p camcraft-app --lib` on `758daa199`:

```text
error: unexpected closing delimiter: `)`
  --> crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:77:10
   |
69 | pub fn do_not_touch_unsupported(kind: OpType) -> Option<String> {
   |                                                                 - the nearest open delimiter
...
77 |         ))
   |         -^ unexpected closing delimiter
   |         |
   |         missing open `(` for this delimiter

error: could not compile `camcraft-app` (lib) due to 1 previous error
```

The function ends after line 76. Delete lines 77-78 (the stray `))` and `}`), then run `cargo check -p camcraft-app --lib`.

## What looks good

The merge kept both sides everywhere except that one hunk:

- `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:52-63` has `Adaptive2D` (#3346) and `Engrave` (#3349); the comment names both.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:51` and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` name Trace, 2D Offset, 2D Adaptive, 3D Pocket, Face, 3D Finish and Engrave.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs` keeps `mod adaptive_avoid` and `mod trace_avoid`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs` keeps the Finish3D, Face, Adaptive2D and Engrave tests; the unsupported note now names 2D Adaptive.
- `crates/app/tests/do_not_touch_support/mod.rs` keeps `setup_plate_and_tower_on` and its `#[allow(dead_code)]`.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` keeps #3346's adaptive keep-out arms and the Engrave `trace_avoid` arm (line 2423).

## Results

On `b7771dd43` (the head before the move), trial-merged with `origin/main` `ddc4d8274`, built and tested locally:

- `camcraft-motion --test avoid_engrave`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app`: `do_not_touch` 5, `do_not_touch_engrave` 3, `do_not_touch_face` 3, `do_not_touch_finish3d` 5, `do_not_touch_project` 3, `engrave_law` 10, all passed.
- `camcraft-ui` lib (`--lib do_not_touch`): 10 passed, 0 failed, including `do_not_touch_engrave::engrave_boundaries_shows_do_not_touch_controls_and_takes_picks` at the `1200` height.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green, independent run on this head.

Pin sensitivity on `b7771dd43`: `trace_avoid.rs:243` changed to `if false && endpoints_blocked` makes `trace_avoid_trims_open_run_endpoints_under_overhead_clearance_blocker` fail with 3 Holder hits at moves 0, 1 and 7 (`short_mm` 4.97, 4.97, 14.0). The code was restored byte for byte and the test is green again.

On `758daa199`: the build stops at the error above, so no suite ran. The light lane was started on `b7771dd43` and stopped when the head moved. It is not a reading for `758daa199`.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:77`: delete lines 77-78 (the duplicated `))` and `}`). Push the fix with the comment, and run the touched suites and the light lane on the new head.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The rest of the merge is a correct keep-both; only this one hunk is broken. A `cargo check -p camcraft-app` before the push finds it.
- The earlier follow-ups stand: one note per trimmed span, and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:171` still names only 2D Offset and 3D Pocket.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9f983e720af68fbc63bd98e33f67748e078982ca -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a delta re-check of head `9f983e720af68fbc63bd98e33f67748e078982ca`. The only hand change since the change-requested review at `758daa199` is the fix commit `9f983e720`. The rest of the head is the merge of `origin/main` `2de071415`. This PR comes from a fork (`paulsvc`), so a maintainer approves and merges it by hand.

## The blocker is fixed

- `crates/app/src/operation/types/avoid.rs:69-78`: the duplicated closers are gone. `do_not_touch_unsupported` now ends after its single `))` and `}`. `cargo check -p camcraft-app --lib` compiles. The fix commit removes exactly 2 lines and touches no other file (`git diff --stat 758daa199 9f983e720` = 1 file, 2 deletions).
- The engrave generator `crates/motion/src/machining2d/trace_avoid.rs` and its suites (`crates/motion/tests/avoid_engrave.rs`, `crates/app/tests/do_not_touch_engrave.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch_engrave.rs`) are byte-identical to `b7771dd43`, where the earlier review found no code blocker. The prior findings therefore stay closed.

## What looks good

- Trial merge with `origin/main` `65b52cca6` is clean (automatic merge, no conflict).
- `trace_avoid` delegates to plain `trace` when `AvoidSpec` is empty, so an unprotected Engrave is unchanged (`empty_avoid_matches_plain_trace_exactly`).
- The safety rules are intact: per-level keep-out clipping with seam rotation and open-run trim, `elevate_rapid_links` over protected items, and an independent `verify_avoid` that blocks the post (`engrave_do_not_touch_refuses_impossible_cut_and_blocks_post`).
- `trace_avoid.rs` is 343 lines with a provenance header and no `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic` outside tests. The other changed source files add none.
- `docs/decisions/3349-engrave-do-not-touch.md` is present. The PR body has a `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #3349`, and `Effort: high`. It does not touch a process file, `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, or a `Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.lock`.

## Results (locally, trial-merged with main)

Ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/cc-pr3549-review`, trial-merged with `origin/main` `65b52cca6` (local merge commit `776f9eeb9`). No `pr-test.yml` run.

- `cargo check -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --lib`: pass.
- `camcraft-motion`:
  - `lib`: 589 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored.
  - `avoid_engrave`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
  - `avoid_pocket`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app`:
  - `do_not_touch`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
  - `do_not_touch_engrave`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
  - `engrave_law`: 10 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass (exit 0). The only line is the cargo manifest note for the unused workspace dependency `truck-polymesh`, which is not a code warning.

## Targeted tests

- No post or recorded program changed; the diff adds no golden file.
- Example catalog: not independently re-run in this delta re-check. The generator is byte-identical to `b7771dd43`, where the earlier review ran `example_catalog` (39 passed, 4 ignored) and the other catalog suites green. The author reports `example_catalog` 39 passed on this head. The catalog examples do not use Engrave with "Do not touch", so this branch is not exercised there. (A plain-cargo debug run of the binary hit a unit-dir artifact after the gate's unit sweep, not a code error: `clippy --all-targets` and the release `--no-run` build of every app test binary both passed.)
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): pass on the trial-merged tree - 4 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Step 01 release build ok (684s on the cold run; 2s cached on the re-run), then `motion light: lib` (26s), `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` (22s) and `app light: pocket_pass_start` (3s). The three light twins do not exercise Engrave avoidance.

## Requested before merge

None. The blocking finding is fixed and the touched suites are green on the merged tree.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/do_not_touch.rs` is 407 lines. It is 407 lines on `origin/main` too, so this PR does not grow it. The split of the engrave test to `do_not_touch_engrave.rs` (52 lines) is kept.
- The `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` row for `set_operation_do_not_touch` still names only `2D Offset` and `3D Pocket`. That file is a process file; a follow-up is correct.
- The follow-up from the earlier review stands: a span trimmed inside a level gives no path note, so a lost engraving segment is not explained to the user. A `P7` follow-up is fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
